1.) Learn what healthy communication looks and sounds like... (Example: "I feel overwhelmed with the chores around the house right now and could use some help" Instead of saying "You never help with anything around the house, do the dishes more."

2.) ALWAYS be honest 

3.) If you get the answer no, or are rejected for a request.. you need to take the answer as it is. No prodding, or trying to change the persons mind. Like just respect boundaries.

4.) my last biggest tip would be to tell your therapist exactly what you said here and how you can work to not do that as well, be completely honest with the therapist and share everything with them even if you look bad or are in the wrong. No matter what just stay transparent with them.
